title: Fix the Array Write Past the End
description: The program should store 5 values in an array sized for exactly 5 elements.
expectedBehavior: The program should fill indices 0 through 4 and print 40.
actualProblem: The loop condition i <= SIZE lets i reach 5, and values[5] is one element past the end of a 5-element array — writing there corrupts adjacent memory (undefined behavior), even though values[4] itself might still print correctly by chance.
explanation: An array of SIZE elements has valid indices 0 through SIZE - 1. Using < SIZE instead of <= SIZE ensures the loop never writes past the last valid element.
